scope.method: Independent architecture and baseline reviews, focused authority and user-flow reviews, source reconciliation, and disposable-copy client regression tests.
exclusions: Unrelated legacy applications and marketplace flows
Public activation, real-wallet signing and production deployment
Arbitrary third-party module correctness and complete compiler/VM refinement
Repository-wide test, build-tool and generated-artifact audit

confirmedCorrections.problem: The client required custody for mature verifier, hook and recovery-address activation, although the native protocol makes these transitions permissionless.
confirmedCorrections.correction: Require only a fee payer for these three activations, retaining fresh account, maturity and simulation checks. Module-policy activation still requires custody.

confirmedCorrections.problem: A module cancellation plan did not retain its role or pending intent; replacement of that intent without changing the account record was not detected.
confirmedCorrections.correction: Capture the existing role and complete pending intent in the immutable plan, and compare it on every revalidation and exported-review rebuild.
confirmedCorrections.boundary: This detects changes already visible at revalidation. It does not reserve the pending state between final preflight and inclusion; the current on-chain cancellation method has no expected-intent argument.

confirmedCorrections.problem: The workspace lacked a pending-policy cancellation flow and its generic wallet invocation omitted the module role.
confirmedCorrections.correction: Expose verifier and hook pending policies, cancellation review and exact accountId/moduleType wallet arguments.

confirmedCorrections.problem: Recovery cancellation appeared permissionless, stale maturity lacked refresh guidance, and Application consumption could be mistaken for the required fee budget.
confirmedCorrections.correction: Display effective authorities, verified chain snapshot time and refresh controls, and separate consumption from admission and network-fee information. Document guardian cooperation and key-loss limits.

cases: Three permissionless activations retain an incorrect custody requirement
Cancellation plan lacks role and pending intent
Replacing pending intent with unchanged account state is not rejected

nativeBrowser.transport: RPC and wallet fixtures; no network transaction

correctedClientAndWorkspace.independentPatchReview: GO for SDK, workspace and documentation; excludes core, deployment and unresolved protocol boundary

openBoundaries.evidence: Source review indicates that another native proxy may be accepted as custody or recovery but lose its witness grant when the governed account acquires its own account lock.
openBoundaries.limit: The isolated validation task was refused by the validation service. No executable confirmation is claimed and no consensus behavior was changed on that basis.
openBoundaries.requiredFollowUp: Validate supported authority forms in the native execution context and specify admission/temporal semantics without weakening target-frame witness isolation.

openBoundaries.evidence: Issue 242 remains a draft design discussion. Upstream review, independently maintained consensus-client conformance and public activation are separate gates.

historicalEvidence: Earlier full native/runtime/formal receipts retain their original source and artifact pins. They were not regenerated by this client and workspace correction.
